shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Three uniformly-efficient per-level sizes (126/190/254) bought from a 146,000-cell budget. Wall-mounted junction and breaker boxes bridge power and pipe networks between levels across six supported utility mods. Per-colony climate bands make high levels genuinely alpine. LIVE IN OPEN BETA as Workshop item 3776015553.
body:
> **NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 utility networks; §31 publishing; §32 pathing cost; §33 cross-level drafted movement; §34 walkable islands. Keep every ⚠ - each cost a run to learn.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> V1 is DELETED. ~83 files, ~26,600 LOC. No em-dashes anywhere in shipped text.

# 0. START HERE

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from above, (2) performance, (3) vanilla parity.

**CURRENT PHASE: SHIPPED, OPEN BETA, BACK IN BUILD MODE.** Workshop item **3776015553** (public). See §31.

**⚠ §9's run log records AGENT-DRIVEN runs only.** The user tests tiers, utility networks, the elevator and the multi-hop router outside Modmixer.

**⚠⚠ THE THREE RULES THIS SESSION COST THE MOST TO LEARN:**
1. **NOTHING COSMETIC MAY SIT ON THE PATH THAT DECIDES WHETHER A TRANSIT HAPPENS** (§33c).
2. **NEVER PATCH `RegionAndRoomUpdater.TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`** - ~4,500 calls/frame; use `map.events.RegionsRoomsChanged` (§34e). **Already documented in ABWormhole.cs and rediscovered the hard way anyway.**
3. **REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER** (§34b). Anything claiming to answer "can this pawn walk there" must flood CELLS with the diagonal rule, never `Region.Neighbors`.

---

## Status
Visuality, QOL, altitude/weather, settings VERIFIED. **✅ §24b ✅ §24c ✅ §27 ✅ §28 ✅ §29 (#260).**
**✅ §2 NEW LADDER generates clean.** **✅ §30 ALL 15 NETWORKS LINK AND ARE EXERCISED.**
**✅ §32b DOOR/PAWN BAND SCOPE VERIFIED (#294).**
**✅ §33 CROSS-LEVEL DRAFTED MOVEMENT WORKS END TO END (#302).** Single AND groups, up AND down, ghosts drawing.
**✅ §33a PATH LINE FIXED (#305).** Root cause: a DUPLICATE pre-existing patch on `PawnPath.DrawPath`.
**✅ §34 WALKABLE ISLANDS VERIFIED (#308).** Multi-building same-band routing works: a pawn on one platform now takes the stairs down, across and up to another platform on the same band.
**⛔ §33c ENTRY ANIMATION REVERTED.** Pop-out only; `ReadyToCarry` BUILT, NOT WIRED.
**🔧 §8b, §25, §30a, §33g BUILT, UNVERIFIED.** **🔧 §32a NEVER FIRED** (needs a raid). **🔧 §32c slider OFF, unexercised.**
**⚠ §34 OPEN RISKS: the flood cost on a wall-build is UNMEASURED, and band 1 reporting only 9% walkable on a Mountainous tile is UNCONFIRMED BY EYE.** See §34f.
**🎨 ART: 87 of 90 riser textures are placeholders. DISCLOSED. HEADLINE BETA GAP.**
**⚠ CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT IS PARTIAL** - down works, up does not render. DISCLOSED.

---

# 1. ARCHITECTURE
One `Map`, size `(w, 1, bandCount * Slot)`. `Slot = ceil((bandHeight + 2) / 64) * 64`; **64-alignment of SLOT is load-bearing**.

**The one insight.** `Region.Neighbors` is *topological, not spatial*. Wormhole `RegionLink`s between one-cell `RegionType.Portal` ends conduct connectivity without merging rooms, temperature or vacuum. Reachability is not a path: 1.6's pathfinder is jobified and cannot traverse a synthetic link, hence segmented movement (§3).

**⚠⚠ AND THAT IS THE SOURCE OF §34.** `CanReach` answers "can I get there USING STAIRS"; the pathfinder answers "can I walk there NOW". **Every `CanReach=True` + `path=NOT FOUND` stall in this project is that gap**, and §34 is the only thing that measures it honestly.
**⚠ THE TOPOLOGICAL TRICK DOES NOT GENERALISE TO UTILITY NETWORKS** - they build from raw CELL ADJACENCY (§30).
**⚠ THE GUTTER IS UNBUILDABLE BY CONSTRUCTION** - `AB_OpenAir` declares no affordances.
**⚠⚠ THE GUTTER IS ALREADY 100% UNPATHABLE IN EVERY MODE, INCLUDING FLYING. DO NOT "HARDEN" IT.** `Impassable` means `CalculatedCostAt` returns 10000 on its FIRST line, `PathGridJob` skips `CostForCell`, `PathFinderJob` drops it at `>= 10000`. `PathGridDef Flying` exempts only `forcePassableByFlyingPawns`, which `AB_OpenAir` does not set. **No movement bug here has ever come from a soft gutter.**
**⚠ THE MOD IS DOWNWARD-ONLY IN THREE PLACES.** `TryResolveVisibleBelow`; the see-through click rule; the combat renderer. **§33b/§33f are the worked examples** for the open combat case (§13 item 2).
**Hard 1.6 constraints.** No `PathFinder.FindPath`. **⚠ The stack is 2x to 7x anisotropic.** Pathfinder cost: **§32**.

### ⚠ THE SLICING RULE, nine shapes
| Shape | Example | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Anchor, a fraction of `Size.z` | river/lake centre; VEE Crater | remap the point |
| Field, a gradient on map centre | coastline; VEE LoneIsland | re-centre the sample |
| Noise space, a slice is not a short map | Map Preview; GL grids; Rimefeller oil | generate full height, then crop |
| Distance-to-extent | `CloseToEdge`; river WIDTH | re-base onto the band rect |
| Aspect ratio, normalised by BOTH dims | preview + reroll grid | lay out from the BAND, generate at the STACK |
| Map-wide scalar | snow melt, temperature, GL roof sweep | rewrite per cell at the consumer |
| Foreign absolute writes | GL landform lands in band 0 | ORDER, not arithmetic |
| Radius search wider than the gutter | `ConnectMaxDist` 6 vs a 3-cell gap | clip the rect to the band |
| **Whole-map list sweep** (§32) | every door / every pawn, per path request | bucket the list per band |

Unaudited: Basin, Cavern, Chasm, Cliffs, Hollow, Valley. **`ABBandLocal.cs` is THE canonical FIELD rewrite** plus `BandLocalModule`.

# 2. LEVEL PLAN — budget 146,000, ladder 7 / 4 / 2

| size | slot | gutter | gap | cost/band | playable | max levels | total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 126 | 128 | 2 | 3 | 16,128 | 98.4% | 7 (cap) | 112,896 |
| **190** | 192 | 2 | 3 | 36,480 | 99.0% | **4** | 145,920 |
| 254 | 256 | 2 | 3 | 65,024 | 99.2% | 2 | 130,048 |

**⚠ EXACTLY ONE MAXIMALLY EFFICIENT HEIGHT PER 64-STEP** (`slot - 2`). Anchoring 190 *determined* the rest.
**⚠ UNIFORM GUTTER IS A TESTING WIN.** **⚠ 318 blocked by arithmetic; 62 deliberately absent.**
**⚠ THE BUDGET'S STATED JUSTIFICATION WAS PARTLY WRONG - THE BUDGET ITSELF IS NOT.** See §32.
**⚠ 200 IS THE ONE NUMBER TO AVOID** - 21.9% wasted. **Waste is a SAWTOOTH.**
**Old saves are safe.** **⚠ THE PLAN PERSISTS BETWEEN COLONIES.** **⚠ Own the widget, do not patch the data.**

# 3-8a. MOVEMENT, MASS, CAMERA
**Cross-band movement** segmented at ONE interception (`Pawn_PathFollower.StartPath`); hops strictly decrease.
**⚠⚠ TWO CARRY TRIGGERS EXIST - THE PER-TICK SWEEP AND `PatherArrived` - AND NOTHING MAY GATE EITHER** (§33c).
**⚠ ONE DESCENT RULE: `TryResolveVisibleBelow`.** TEN systems share it; NINE appearances of the single-step bug.
**⚠ THE BELOW VIEW IS MIRRORED PASSES, NOT ONE RENDERER.** **⚠ THREE THINGS ARE CALLED "MASS".** **⚠ VISIBILITY IS `ABBands.ShowsBelow(terrain)`.**
**⚠ EVERY FOREIGN NETWORK SHIPS ITS OWN `SectionLayer` AND NONE ARE MIRRORED** (§30f).
**Water** is TWO-PASS SCREEN-SPACE, **all three patches inert under GL**.
**⚠ PERSPECTIVE MODE WAS BUILT AND REMOVED. Do not re-add as polish.**
Ore `x(1+0.45*(depth-1))`. **⚠ The snow line never worked.** Camera clamp + level-switch share `ABGuard.Camera`.

# 8b. THE DEPTH SHRINK — SCOPE IS LOOSE CONTENTS ONLY
**⚠ BUILDINGS DO NOT SHRINK: `CanShrink` IS AN ALLOW-LIST ON `ThingDef.category`** (Item, Plant, Filth). **Pawns take the realtime path and DO shrink.**
**⚠ THE REASON IS THAT TERRAIN IS NEVER SHRUNK.** HARD rule.
**⚠ THE PAWN MATRIX CARRIES TWO EFFECTS AND THEY MULTIPLY IN ONE POSTFIX.** Do not add a second `[HarmonyPatch]` on `GetDrawParms`.

# 9. GENERATION COST
**9a.** The profile stamps its own conditions; has voided or explained EIGHT comparisons. **⚠ THE WATER REPORT DOES NOT AND SHOULD.**
**OLD best:** #255 5x190 Boreal ~4.1 s. **NEW (all 5x126):** #278 **~1.6 s** | #277 +Caves +River ~3.4 s | **#294-#308 Mountainous ExtremeDesert ~3.1 s** (carve 1,998 ms, **1,575 of it `FillRock band 0`**).
**⚠ THE NEW LADDER'S WHOLE RANGE SITS BELOW THE OLD LADDER'S BEST.**
**⚠ FillRock is SUPERLINEAR in band size.** **⚠ RAINFALL DOMINATES `GenStep_Plants`** (21x spread). **⚠ THE `Caves` CLAIM IS DEMOTED** (n=2 was not a pattern). **⚠ HILLINESS DECIDES WHETHER A RENDERING TEST IS VALID AT ALL** - and now whether a PATHING test is valid, since it decides how fragmented the bands are (§34f).
**⚠ `Pathing.RecalculateAllPerceivedPathCosts` RUNS AT EVERY `Map.FinalizeInit`, ONCE PER `PathGridDef` WITH A WORKER.**
**9g.** 1. **Basement rock suppression**. 2. `GenStep_Plants` (demoted). 3. `GenStep_RockChunks`. 4. Ruins. 5. Perlin precompute.

# 10-12. PERF AND DIAGNOSTICS
59.6 fps at 96 pawns. **⚠ THAT MEASURES THE WRONG THING** - cost is in BURSTS.
**⚠ BISECT TOGGLES PERSIST ACROSS RUNS, AND THE STAMP IS WHY WE CATCH IT.**
**⚠ The pre-pinned palette always strips its LAST entry. n=27.** Pad with a DISTINCT throwaway.
**⚠ OUR REPORT LINES ARRIVE AS `warning` ROWS ATTRIBUTED TO US.** **Info is filtered out of the bridge.**
**⚠⚠ A CLEAN LOG IS NOT A WORKING FEATURE.** #297-#300 logged nothing but the generation profile while group cross-level movement was completely broken. **Never report "clean run" as evidence.** What it does prove, free: no `Skipped patch class` means every `[HarmonyPatch]` resolved its target.
**⚠⚠ ASK FOR THE EXISTING DIAGNOSTIC BEFORE THE FIRST GUESS, NOT THE THIRD.** `AB2: band info` and `AB2: why is this pawn stuck` sat pinned and unused for four runs while three wrong theories shipped. Run finally, they solved it in two readings.
**⚠⚠ WHEN YOU CANNOT TELL WHICH OF YOUR PATCHES DID IT, TRAP THE SHARED FUNNEL.** `AB2: trap vertical lines` prefixes `GenDraw.DrawLineBetween`, tests |Δz| ≈ Slot, logs a trimmed stack trace. Named the culprit in ONE run after two wrong inferences from a screenshot - and it was a patch that predated the investigation. **Keep it.**
**⚠ A DIAGNOSTIC MUST PRINT THE INTERMEDIATE VALUES, NOT THE VERDICT.** The stuck probe earning its keep at #307 came from printing `component: pawn=3 dest=3` alongside `CanReach=True` and `FindPathNow=NOT FOUND` - three facts that contradicted each other and named the design error immediately.
**⚠ AN ERROR HASH IS A STACK SIGNATURE, NOT A FILE.**
**⚠ TWO COUNTERS IN DIFFERENT PATCHES THAT SHOULD TRACK 1:1 ARE A FREE CROSS-CHECK** (#294: 433 vs 432).

# 13. OPEN WORK
1. **ART.** 87 of 90 riser textures are placeholders - a public promise.
2. **CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT: upward shooting does not render.**
3. **§34f: MEASURE THE FLOOD.** Build a wall on a fragmented band and time the hitch. Unmeasured.
4. **§34f: CONFIRM BAND-1 WALKABILITY BY EYE.** #308 reported 1,490 of 15,876 (9%) walkable on the surface of a Mountainous tile, LESS than the sky band above it. Plausible (surface buried in rock, sky bands are open plateaus) but unverified.
5. **VERIFY §33g, §8b, §30a, §25.** 6. **VERIFY §32a with a raid.** 7. **§32c slider unexercised.**
8. **`rebuilds` is printed BEFORE the loop that rebuilds** in the component report - cosmetically understates by up to bandCount. Cosmetic only.
9. **§33c entry animation: redesign from outside the carry decision, or drop it.**
10. **Basement rock suppression.** 11. **§30 polish:** `PipeGrid[P, cell]` not rewritten on merge (cosmetic).
12. §18 audit; VEE compat; GL roof fix; reroll grid; camera anchor; preview at 254.
13. **Never exercised:** basement PATHING, cavern basement.
14. §22 TABLED. 15. CAI 5000 (§26). 16. §30g. 17. §30e Rimefeller oil.
18. **Delete orphaned Workshop item 3773267907.** 19. **§32f.**

# 14. LESSONS
**Method.** Prove a subsystem innocent by finding a state where the suspect CANNOT EXIST. Change one thing per experiment. **Run the diagnostic before the first theory.** A beautiful fit is not evidence.
**⚠⚠ A DERIVED ANSWER CANNOT BE MORE ACCURATE THAN ITS SOURCE** (§34b). Islands built from `Region.Neighbors` matched `CanReach` exactly - and `CanReach` was the thing being second-guessed, so the map was structurally incapable of seeing the failure. Measured as `component: pawn=3 dest=3` with `FindPathNow=NOT FOUND`. **Before building an index to catch a subsystem lying, check that you are not building it out of the lie.**
**⚠⚠ ONE USER GESTURE CAN HAVE THREE CODE PATHS. FIXING ONE LOOKS EXACTLY LIKE FIXING THE FEATURE** (§33f). **Enumerate every handler for a gesture before declaring it done.**
**⚠⚠ A COSMETIC EFFECT MUST NEVER SIT ON THE CODE PATH THAT DECIDES WHETHER THE FEATURE HAPPENS** (§33c). Bounded, self-cancelling, timeout-covered - **all true, all beside the point, because the thing it blocked was the loop's own exit condition.**
**⚠⚠ WHEN THE REVERT DOES NOT FIX IT, THE HYPOTHESIS WAS WRONG - STOP EXTENDING IT.**
**⚠⚠ CHECK WHETHER IT IS ALREADY BUILT - AND WHETHER THE MISTAKE IS ALREADY DOCUMENTED.** Six times this session, including a duplicate patch on `PawnPath.DrawPath` and an `AnythingToRebuild` gate that ABWormhole.cs already recorded as ineffective. **Grep your own source for the target, and READ THE NEIGHBOURING COMMENTS.**
**⚠ A THRESHOLD ON A FAST-PATH FLAG NEEDS A MINIMUM MAGNITUDE.** A ONE-CELL pocket set `anyFragmented=True` and forced every `StartPath` on the map onto the slow branch. **Gate flags on "is this worth caring about", not "does this exist".**
**⚠ VISIBILITY-GATE A MARKER, GEOMETRICALLY LIFT A CHAIN** (§33a).
**⚠ WHEN A CORE FEATURE REGRESSES, REVERT FIRST AND DIAGNOSE AFTER.**
**⚠ A CORRECT PRINCIPLE APPLIED TO THE WRONG THING IS STILL A BUG.**
**⚠ A GUARD THAT FIRES UNCONDITIONALLY IS NOT THE SAME AS A GUARD THAT FIRES ON ITS TRIGGER** (§33f).
**⚠ WHEN YOU MAKE TWO THINGS AGREE, ASK WHICH ONE IS RIGHT.** **Coherence is not correctness.**
**⚠ "NOT SAME" IS NOT "KNOWN DIFFERENT"** (§34). Unknown must mean LEAVE IT ALONE. **A three-valued answer needs a three-valued test.**
**⚠ AN ARITHMETIC SIGNATURE IN A DIAGNOSTIC NAMES THE GUILTY METHOD.** Click `(35,347)` -> destination `(35,219)` is exactly one Slot.
**⚠ FIXING A HELPER DOES NOT FIX ITS CALL SITES - AUDIT THEM** (§33a).
**⚠ THREE COPIES OF ONE TRANSFORM, TWO OF THEM RIGHT.** The majority being correct is why the odd one survived.
**⚠ A SYMPTOM CAN BE TWO DEFECTS WITH OPPOSITE FIXES - AND THEN A THIRD, AND A FOURTH** (§33a).
**⚠ WHEN YOU COPY A LOOP OUT OF ENGINE CODE, COPY ITS DIRECTION TOO.** `Peek(n)` = `nodes[curNodeIndex - n]`. **Check against a route that TURNS.**
**⚠ A STATELESS EFFECT IS WORTH NOTHING IF THE STATE IT READS NEVER CHANGES** (§33c).
**⚠ REUSING A RADIUS IS REUSING ITS REASONS.** **Two questions, two constants.**
**⚠ NEVER CALL A SYNCHRONOUS PATHFIND FROM A DRAW CALLBACK** (§33g).
**⚠ WHEN THE USER PROPOSES A FIX, CHECK WHETHER THE PREMISE IS ALREADY TRUE.** "Make the gutter unpathable" - it already is, three ways over. **Take the symptom seriously and the proposed mechanism sceptically**; the real defect was §34.
**⚠ A BURST-COMPILED METHOD CANNOT BE HARMONY PATCHED, AND FAILS SILENTLY.** **Corollary: a job holding MANAGED references IS patchable.**
**⚠ A PERFORMANCE CLAIM COPIED INTO THREE FILES IS STILL ONE UNVERIFIED CLAIM** (§32).
**⚠ THE CHEAPEST OPTIMISATION IS DELETING WORK THAT CANNOT MATTER.**
**⚠ AN OVERLAY MUST AGREE WITH WHERE THE RENDERER PUTS THE THING, NOT WHERE THE THING IS** (§33a).
**⚠ A GUARD CLAUSE THAT SILENTLY EARLY-RETURNS IS INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM AN UNIMPLEMENTED FEATURE** - and **instrumenting three of five early returns is the same mistake as instrumenting none** (§33e).
**⚠ THE AGENT'S TEST LOG IS NOT THE PROJECT'S TEST HISTORY.** **Before writing an untested claim into player-facing copy, ASK.**
**⚠ CHECK THAT YOUR CONFIGURATION CAN EXPRESS THE DIFFERENCE** - and a GENERATED map may not be able to. §34 needed a hand-BUILT fixture; generated sky bands came out effectively unfragmented under the old measure.
**⚠ A QUANTISED PARAMETER HAS FEWER LEGAL VALUES THAN IT LOOKS.** **⚠ A BUDGET SET BY THE HEAVIEST OPTION IS PAID BY EVERY USER.** **⚠ A COST MODEL CAN GOVERN THE WRONG AXIS AND STILL LOOK CORRECT.** **⚠ IF THE CHEAPEST OPTION LOOKS LIKE THE MOST EXPENSIVE, THE UI IS LYING.** **⚠ n=2 IS NOT A PATTERN, AND NEITHER IS n=4.**
**⚠ HALF-IMPOSED ORDERING IS WORSE THAN NONE.** **⚠ COUNT THE EMITTERS BEFORE FIXING THE LOOK.** **⚠ CLEAR THE OTHER SUSPECT BY READING ITS DATA, NOT ITS CODE.** **⚠ A FIX FOR MOD X CAN BE A REGRESSION FOR EVERYONE WITHOUT X.** **⚠ REPRODUCING A SUBSYSTEM MEANS REPRODUCING ALL OF IT.** **⚠ REUSING A PREDICATE IS REUSING ITS HIDDEN CONDITIONS.** **⚠ TWO RESOLVERS FOR ONE QUANTITY IS A BUG WITH A DELAY FUSE.**
**⚠ N MODS CAN BE FEWER THAN N PROBLEMS.** **⚠ A FOREIGN MOD'S OWN DEFS CAN BE WRONG.** **⚠ A DEPENDENCY LIST NAMES THE REAL PATCH TARGET.** **⚠ AN ENUM IS A CAPABILITY LIST, NOT A CONTENT LIST.** **⚠ A DECOMPILE SHOWS THE API OF THE VERSION THAT MOD WAS BUILT AGAINST.**
**⚠ Compat work is mostly deletion.** **⚠ Waste is often a sawtooth.** **⚠ A comment that has gone FALSE is worse than none.** **⚠ Steady-state fps hides burst cost.** **⚠ Timing that reads exactly 0.0 ms is an early return.** **⚠ In a foreign log, the loudest error is usually downstream.**
**Patching.** **Wrap the DATA instead of the reader** (§32). Patch the PRODUCER, not the store. Own the widget. **Never put a foreign type in a patch signature**; **omit a PRIVATE NESTED STRUCT param - Harmony binds by name.** **Prefix state is released in a Finalizer.** **Prefer "detect, then redo" over "always redo".**
**⚠ PREFER A VANILLA EVENT TO A PATCH ON A HOT METHOD.** `MapEvents.RegionsRoomsChanged` fires once per real region rebuild; the method raising it is called ~4,500x/frame. **Look for the notification before reaching for Harmony.**
**⚠ REIMPLEMENT RATHER THAN POSTFIX WHEN THE GEOMETRY IS A CHAIN** - and **you then own every branch of the original, including the ones you did not notice.**
**Engine facts.** `SnowGrid.CanHaveSnow` rejects on `holdSnowOrSand=false` OR a Full-fillage edifice. A `TerrainHard` shader IGNORES vertex alpha; set `renderQueue` AFTER shader assignment. **Draw order between terrain materials is render QUEUE.** A `dontRender` terrain emits only a ShadowMask. `Banded` is FALSE during map generation. FinalizeInit runs on a worker thread. **Gensteps run with live-map bookkeeping DEFERRED.** Harmony always runs FINALIZERS. **`FogGrid` is a `NativeBitArray` in 1.6.** **`Graphic_Multi.Init` falls back to `_east` with `westFlipped`.**
**⚠⚠ PATHING vs REGION FACTS (§34).** **A region is a CELL SET; path production ALSO refuses a diagonal step when either flanking cell blocks it** (`PathUtility.BlocksDiagonalMovement(x, z, pathingContext, canBashFences)`, applied in `Pawn_PathFollower`). Two areas touching only at a corner past an impassable cell are ONE REGION and NOT WALKABLE. **`map.pathing.Normal` is the `PathingContext`; `PathingContext.pathGrid` and `.map` are public; `PathGrid.WalkableFast` takes a cell, an index, or x/z.** **`TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` IS CALLED ~4,500 TIMES PER FRAME AND MUST NEVER BE PATCHED** - a gating prefix recovers only 22% because the gate is itself Harmony dispatch. Use `map.events.RegionsRoomsChanged`. `Region.AnyCell` is guaranteed inside the region; `extentsClose.CenterCell` is NOT. **A region can never straddle the gutter.**
**⚠ ORDERING FACTS (§33f).** ONE pawn: `Selector.HandleMultiselectGoto` / `FloatMenuOptionProvider_DraftedMove` take a `Count == 1` branch to `PawnGotoAction` via `RCellFinder.BestOrderedGotoDestNear`. TWO OR MORE: `gotoController.StartInteraction` + `AddPawn`; `MultiPawnGotoController` owns destinations (`root = start + (end-start) * j/(count-1)`) **and the destination GHOST** (`RenderPawnAt`, skipped on `Fogged`). **`active` is set only by `AddPawn`, so one pawn draws no ghost at all.** **`ProcessInputEvents` assigns `end = UI.MouseCell()` RAW.**
**⚠ RENDERER FACTS THAT BIT TWICE.** Past `ZoomRootSize` 18 a humanlike renders from a **cached atlas blit that ignores `PawnDrawParms.matrix`** - fix is `disableCache`. **`GetDrawParms` is reached from `ParallelPreDraw`, potentially on WORKER THREADS** - gate dictionary probes behind a plain int count. **`PawnDrawParms.pawn` gives you the pawn.** **A uniform x/z Scale commutes with facing rotation and can be right-multiplied; a TRANSLATION cannot.**
**⚠ WALL-MOUNTED DRAW LAYER IS `Item`.** **⚠ SOUTH-FACING WALL MOUNTS NEED ZERO DRAW OFFSET WHILE N/E/W NEED 0.9.**
**⚠⚠ TWO UNRELATED "WALL-MOUNTED" MECHANISMS IN DIFFERENT CELLS.** `isAttachment` takes the cell BESIDE a wall and **needs `supportsWallAttachments`, which ORDINARY WALLS DO NOT HAVE**. `canPlaceOverWall` takes the WALL'S OWN cell. **`isEdifice=false` + `clearBuildingArea=false` both load-bearing.**
**⚠ POWER FACTS.** `ContiguousPowerBuildings` is PRIVATE. **`ConnectMaxDist = 6`** with NO line-of-sight check. **`Building.TransmitsPowerNow` is VIRTUAL and the base IGNORES flicking.** **⚠ A `private const` IS INLINED AND CANNOT BE READ BY REFLECTION.**
**⚠ PATHFINDER FACTS (§32).** `PathGridJob` deduped per VARIANT per tick, **`Area`/`AvoidGrid` in the key**. `PathFinderJob.Execute` opens with `calcGrid.Clear()` (20 B/cell). `PathFinderTick` opens with `ForceCompleteScheduledJobs()`. `FindPathNow` is SYNCHRONOUS. **`PawnPath` is POOLED.** **`Peek(n)` = `nodes[curNodeIndex - n]`.**
**⚠ `HashSet<T>` implements `ICollection<T>` but NOT the non-generic `ICollection`.**
**⚠ TEXTURE FACTS.** **Core textures are PACKED.** **TWO art families**: Dubwise thick outline; Vanilla/VE almost none.

---

# 15-19. QOL / WEATHER / SETTINGS / AUDIT
**15a.** Nothing may exist in the void. **⚠ The sweep moves PAWNS ONLY.** **15b.** `CloseToEdge` re-based onto the band rect. **15c. ⚠ `SeamMarginFor` is DERIVED.** **15d.** No-build edge REMOVED. **15e.** Drop pods fall through.
**16.** Melt per band rewrites the private `outdoorMeltAmount`; **ReGrowth transpiles the same method and composes.**
**17. ⚠ The blank-tab bug:** a SELF-SUSTAINING LATCH without a floor. **⚠ Draw the diagnostic OUTSIDE the thing being diagnosed.**
**18a.** Prefix state released in a Postfix - all now `Finalizer`. **18b.** Same symptom, different cause. **18e. CLOSED.**
**19.** The 910-mod failure was **not us** - a NEGATIVE `startingPawnCount`.

# 34. WALKABLE ISLANDS — ✅ VERIFIED (#308)

## 34a. THE PROBLEM
`TrySegment` early-returned on `SameBand`, assuming same band implies reachable within the band. On a fragmented band it does not - two plateaus, or two buildings' upper floors. We declined to segment, vanilla found no path, but **`CanReach` had already said TRUE**. The router had the same flaw: `HopDistances` BFSed over BANDS and could return a wormhole whose near anchor was in an island the pawn could not reach.

## 34b. ⚠⚠ THE MISTAKE THAT COST A WHOLE ITERATION
The first implementation flooded **`Region.Neighbors`**. That produces components identical to `CanReach` - **the very thing being second-guessed** - so it was structurally incapable of detecting the failure. Measured on the real fixture: `component: pawn=3 dest=3`, `CanReach=True`, `FindPathNow=NOT FOUND`.
**The fix floods CELLS with the pathfinder's own two rules:** `PathGrid.WalkableFast` for the cell, and `PathUtility.BlocksDiagonalMovement` on BOTH flanking cells of a diagonal step - the identical pair `Pawn_PathFollower` applies. **A region is a cell set; path production additionally refuses diagonal corners.** Sky bands are full of single-cell holes, so corner-only touches merge in the region graph and are not walkable.
**⚠ IF THIS EVER DISAGREES WITH THE PATHFINDER AGAIN, THAT IS THE BUG. Do not paper over it at the consumer.**

## 34c. THE SOFTENINGS
- **PER-BAND REBUILD.** ~16k cells for one 126 band, not ~80k for the stack. `RegionsRoomsChanged` does not say which band changed, so all are marked stale and each re-floods lazily on first query. Bound: one flood per band per region rebuild, **not per query**.
- **`MinIslandCells = 12` GATES THE FRAGMENTED FLAG.** A ONE-CELL pocket previously set it and forced every `StartPath` onto the slow branch. The flag is a hot-path gate, not a fact - `ComponentOf` still reports tiny islands truthfully.
- **`KnownDifferentComponents` IS NOT `!SameComponent`.** Unknown (-1) must mean LEAVE IT ALONE.

## 34e. ⚠⚠ THE INVALIDATION DEFECT — ALREADY DOCUMENTED, REDISCOVERED ANYWAY
Phase 1 reported **`version=759324`** on a quiet map. `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms` is called **~4,500 times per frame**, and the obvious gate (prefix on `AnythingToRebuild`) **had already been tried and rejected in ABWormhole.cs** - it recovers 22% because the gate is itself Harmony dispatch. **Both patches deleted; invalidation is `map.events.RegionsRoomsChanged`**, registered from `ABBandMap`. After the switch: `version=4`.

## 34f. OPEN RISKS
**⚠ THE FLOOD COST ON A WALL-BUILD IS UNMEASURED.** Every band of a mountainous map now reports FRAGMENTED, so the fast-path gate saves nothing there and a ~16k-cell flood re-runs per band per region change.
**⚠ BAND 1 REPORTING 1,490 OF 15,876 WALKABLE (9%) IS UNCONFIRMED BY EYE.** Less than the sky band above it. Plausible on a Mountainous tile (surface buried in rock, sky bands are open plateaus) and consistent with `walkable` now counting strictly pathable cells where the old figure summed region cell counts including impassable-freeform regions - but **verify before trusting the absolute numbers.**
**⚠ PAWNS NOW TAKE LONG DOWN-ACROSS-UP TRIPS THEY PREVIOUSLY REFUSED.** Correct, but it reads as new behaviour and hauling across a fragmented sky band can get expensive.
